reason: New seller with no reviews and I have no idea how long they've been around, so I'd be handing over £300 on faith. I also don't want someone coming to my home or having to sort out collection, and I'd be stuck if the wheels turned out to be bent.
objection: No reviews and no track record. £300 is a lot on my wage to hand over to someone I can't check up on, and a 7-day return only works if I can prove the wheels are undamaged.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews from local customers, or being able to see the wheels in person before paying, with a pay-on-collection option.
